Impact Substitutes, Stunning Finishes & Last-Minute Drama in the MG Indian Super League!
Some players change the game the moment they step onto the pitch!
This compilation brings you the most exciting moments of impact substitutes and dramatic late goals from the MG Indian Super League.
Watch the action unfold:
92nd-Minute Drama: A goalkeeper's spill creates the perfect opportunity for a dramatic late goal!
Mohammed Sanan & Andre Green Deliver: Substitute Mohammed Sanan drives the attack as Andre Green makes the most of the pressure and loose possession to find the back of the net.
